settings.q: Can you model our specific equipment?
settings.a: Yes - send drawings or photos and we'll build an accurate scale model.

settings.q: Can it have moving or cutaway parts?
settings.a: Yes, moving and cutaway elements can be built to demonstrate operation.

settings.q: Can it be branded and cased?
settings.a: Yes, branding and a clear case are available.
Yes, we ship worldwide from Dubai, carefully packed.

settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale model of a technical equipment unit - structural frame, rotating components and drive shaft reproduced to scale on a base. A clear demonstration and showcase piece for engineering and equipment firms.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your equipment, branding, scale and base
settings.s1_body: Specialist equipment is hard to explain in words. We reproduce it as an accurate scale model - frame, rotating parts, drive shaft and fittings - built from your drawings and finished on a base. A powerful demonstration and showcase tool for engineering firms, equipment makers and training, on the stand and in client meetings.
settings.case_body: Built for an equipment firm, this model let the team show clients exactly how the unit was configured and worked - a tangible demonstration that landed far better than a datasheet.
settings.case_quote: Clients understood our equipment instantly. A superb tool for meetings and exhibitions.
settings.prov_p: The more technical the equipment, the more a model helps. Seeing it in 3D turns a complex explanation into instant understanding.
